facts: LR Wheels N Lifts, Tampa. Address on the page and in our listing: 6923 W Hillsborough Ave, Tampa, FL 33634. Phone (813) 464-9023. Website https://lrwheelsnlifts.com/.

The FAQ says hours are Mon-Fri 9AM-6PM, Sat 9AM-3PM, Sun by appointment. Book online any time or call. Example wheel prices printed on the page include Cali Off-Road Vertex 20x10 $500, American Force AFW ATOM SS 20 inch by 9 inch $886, and KMC KM556 CRUX 18 inch by 9 inch $420. The page also names Toyo, Fuel, XD, Black Rhino, Rough Country, BDS, and Milestar.
